analysis.sampling: N=4 is a purposive feasibility sample, not drawn to support inference; no p-value, confidence interval, effect size or power calculation is computed or reported

authorization_gates: implementation review at immutable head with green CI
fresh one-time grant for a PAIRED offline preflight exercising both conditions in one pass
separate fresh authorization for exactly one ON run and exactly one OFF run, each naming the model, budget and cap in the authorization text

binding_status.consequence: The declared-but-unbound list is a set of blocking preconditions. Until every entry is implemented and demonstrated under a paired offline preflight, the frozen block states an intention rather than a binding and no paid Study 2 run may be authorized.

comparison_type.reason: Prompt text, task decomposition and call structure necessarily differ between the conditions and are constitutive of orchestration, not incidental to it. No design can hold them constant while varying orchestration. Every observed difference is attributable to the system as a whole, never to orchestration as an isolated mechanism.

VEGO_AI_OFF.detector_v1_reason: no inter-agent episodes exist; absence of a measuring unit is not a zero-alert observation

VEGO_AI_ON.detector_v1_configuration: must be the identical version-pinned Study 1 configuration - same signals, thresholds and alert classes - cited by module path and digest; no post-outcome tuning

forbidden_claims: that orchestration alone caused any observed difference
any cross-condition comparison of alert rates, counts or proportions

frozen._note: Entries here are the intended configuration. See binding_status for which of them the code actually enforces; several do not.

model_factor.deferred_to: Study 2B, separately preregistered, own denominators, no pooling
model_factor.note: Varying the model alongside orchestration would confound the two.

non_shared_outcomes.detector_v1: ON only; OFF denominator is NOT_APPLICABLE

does_not_prove: that OFF contains no hidden Q&A
that only orchestration differs - see comparison_type
offline_preflight.fixture_content: Both conditions emit empty mapping and fragment lists by construction, so every per-case comparison row is 0 versus 0. The fixture demonstrates plumbing and schema shape only and carries no comparative content.
proves: no provider construction on the fixture path

primary_outcome.agreement: ordinal agreement reported per dimension, always, including when poor; minimum acceptable alpha 0.60, below which the dimension is reported AGREEMENT_INSUFFICIENT and is not interpreted
primary_outcome.composite_index: PROHIBITED - dimensions are never summed or averaged
primary_outcome.fallback: NOT_COLLECTED - secondary outcomes are never promoted to primary
primary_outcome.instrument_status: NOT_BUILT - no labelling plan or rubric anchors exist yet
primary_outcome.judges: at least two independent judges; a VEGO-AI author is a declared interest
primary_outcome.measure: blinded human-rubric quality of the shared per-case output

prohibited_degrees_of_freedom: model switching after any outcome is observed
changing prompts, temperature or corpus after any outcome is observed
re-running a condition after seeing its result
requires: separate independent review and fresh authorization per paid condition

shared_outcomes.note: The three unmeasurable outcomes have no token accounting, no price model and no status field anywhere in the Study 2 code. They are secondary and descriptive; a cheaper or faster condition is not thereby better.

study_separation.note: Study 1 counts are never combined with Study 2 counts.

supersedes.reason: v1 declared orchestration the only varying factor, presented unbound controls as frozen, listed unmeasurable shared outcomes, and defined no primary outcome.
